records.text: Tor Qureshi was stationed at Fort Huachuca and trained there using reconnaissance drones.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, again, can't say that's what it was used for, but what I can state. Is that someone else is in Ahmed Qureshi's family and Tor Qureshi is his name and he was in fact stationed at Fort Huachuca. Same family, according to Tor Qureshi's LinkedIn, he trained there using reconnaissance drones.

verification.notes: Transcript attributes this to a LinkedIn profile. An Army Aviation Association publication confirms Tor Qureshi graduated from a UAS operator course at Fort Huachuca, supporting drone training there. The accessible record does not independently establish that he was stationed there or specifically operated reconnaissance missions.

sources.title: Army Aviation Magazine: People on the Move
sources.relevance: Lists Tor Qureshi among graduates of the UAS Operator Course at Fort Huachuca.

links.title: Family military tie is not a role
